d:
Daya convinces Jethalal to try on his old, tight wedding safari suit. When Bapuji slips on the stairs outside, Jethalal rushes down to help in that exact outfit, causing everyone in the society—especially Iyer and Babita—to burst out laughing at his look.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
